hypothesis: Mean net_sales differs between late and on-time revenue lines
assumptions: Independent observations (order lines in a public extract may be clustered)
Approximate normality of means via CLT; variances need not be equal
limitations: Not a randomized experiment; p-values are descriptive

mean_late_ci.method: Student t interval on the mean (iid assumption)

mean_ontime_ci.method: Student t interval on the mean (iid assumption)
